posts.text: The treatment of Titan (Saturn’s moon) on For All Mankind is disappointing. Titan has 14% of Earth’s gravity but a denser atmosphere. A 200 lb person would weigh 28 lbs. They’re treating it like rock climbing is hard when in reality Titan is the only place in the solar system where a human could theoretically put on artificial wings and fly just by flapping their arms. Would have been much cooler to capture that kind of weirdness.

“Good morning. It’s Sunday. We overdid it yesterday and now I am limpy. Thumb guy saw me limping when we got outside and cancelled the morning walk and took us back  inside after I did my personal business. I appreciated that. But then he left me home alone while he went off with Zoe for an adventure. It was very scary.  What if a mean dog broke down the door? But I was brave. Also, I love you.”

Rhetoric is no longer the art of probing what men believe they ought to believe (apologies to Wayne Booth).


Aaron Reichlin-Melnick (@ReichlinMelnick)

I will never get used to this kind of obscenity being used in an official statement by the White House Communication Director.

The White House no longer aspires to lead from a higher moral vantage point, it seeks to fight in the mud with the pigs.
